# Example: Stockwatch

# 1\. Overview

## 1.1 Product Design

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Stockwatch is positioned as a convenient tool for users to receive daily updates about their desired stocks without leaving SeaTalk. The bot will have 4 main functions that can be utilized in**both private and group chats**:

* Send a Welcome Greeting
* Send a daily stock updates
* Watchlist management
* Provide a functionality support

### **1.1.1 Send a Welcome Greeting**

The bot will send a welcome greeting message to a user or group right after the user subscribed to the bot or when the bot joined the group. The message will look like the picture below.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

### **1.1.2 Send daily stock updates**

Everyday at 9am (based on user's timezone), if user's watchlist is not empty, the bot will send out a daily stock update message like the one below

![](data:image/png;base64,)

### **1.1.3 Watchlist management**

The bot will also respond to certain commands sent by user, like`/list`,`/add <ticker_name>`, and`/remove <ticker_name>`. These commands will be useful for user to manage their watchlist, either to view all stocks in the watchlist, add a new stock into it, or simply remove a stock out of it.

* command`/list`(view all stocks in the watchlist)

![](data:image/png;base64,)

* command`/add <ticker_name>`(add a new stock to the watchlist)

![](data:image/png;base64,)

* command`/remove <ticker_name>`(remove a stock from the watchlist)

![](data:image/png;base64,)

### **1.1.4 Provide a functionality support**

In order to help users to understand better the bot's capability, the bot will also provide a guidance (like the one below) on how user can interact with the bot, whenever user send a command`/help`

![](data:image/png;base64,)

## 1.2 System Design

In this section, we'll take a look at how Stockwatch is put together. We'll break down the main parts of the system and how they work together to send daily stock updates to Seatalk users and groups. This will give you a clear picture of how Stockwatch operates behind the scenes.

### **1.2.1 High Level Architecture**

![](data:image/png;base64,)

**1.2.1.1 System Deployment**

|Service Name|Description|
|---|---|
|Bot API Web Service|An entry point for event callback received from SeaTalk Open Platform (SOP) and to send message to user.|
|Bot Cron Service|A service for updating stock's information, maintain user's watchlist, and sending daily user's stock watchlist.|

**1.2.1.2 System Components**

|Service Name|Description|
|---|---|
|MySQL Database|Persistence relational database|

**1.2.1.2 System Dependencies**

|Component Name|Description|
|---|---|
|SeaTalk Open Platform|External platform that send Event Callback when user sent message to the bot and also provide API to communicate and perform actions related to Seatalk.|
|External Stock API Providers|To get stock daily price and other info, we'll use this system. The providers are stockanalysis.com and finnhub.io|

### **1.2.2 Data Layer**

![](data:image/png;base64,)

**1.2.2.1 subscriber\_tab**

Store user's subscriber or user's inviter (if invited to a group chat) profile information.

* Schema

|Column Name|Type|Additional Property|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|id|bigint|unsigned, not null, auto increment||
|created\_at|bigint|unsigned, not null|unix timestamp in milliseconds|
|updated\_at|bigint|unsigned, not null|unix timestamp in milliseconds|
|region|varchar (2)|default "SG"|Region of a user or group, default to SG|
|language|varchar (20)|not null|Subscriber's preference of language (eg: en, id, th, zh-hant, etc). SeaTalk language docs|
|employee\_code|varchar(191)|not null|SeaTalk employee code of user that subscribe to a bot or invite the bot to a group|
|seatalk\_id|varchar(191)|not null|SeaTalk Id of a user|
|group\_id|varchar(191)|unique, nullable|SeaTalk Group ID if a bot is invited to a group chat|

* Index

|Name|Column|
|---|---|
|primary key|id|
|idx\_employeecode|1. employee\_code|

**1.2.2.2 stock\_subscriber\_watchlist\_tab**

used to keep track of subscriber's stock watchlist

* schema

|Column Name|Type|Additional Property|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|id|bigint|unsigned, not null, auto increment||
|subscriber\_id|bigint|unsigned, not null|reference to id in subscriber\_tab|
|stock\_company\_id|bigint|unsigned, not null|reference to id in stock\_company\_tab|

* Index

|Name|Column|
|---|---|
|primary key|id|
|idx\_subscriberid|subscriber\_id|
|idx\_stockcompanyid|stock\_company\_id|

**1.2.2.3 stock\_company\_tab**

Stores each stock information that will be updated daily if exist is user's watchlist.

* Schema

|Column Name|Type|Additional Property|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|id|bigint|unsigned, not null, auto increment||
|ticker|varchar(20)|not null, unique|ticker of a stock, e.g: "SE", "AAPL", "GOOG", etc.|
|company\_name|varchar(191)||Name of the company, e.g: "Sea Limited", "Apple Inc", etc.|
|curr\_close\_price|decimal(12,4)|unsigned|Price of the latest (current) stock when the market close.|
|curr\_open\_price|decimal(12,4)|unsigned|Price of the latest (current) stock when the market open.|
|prev\_close\_price|decimal(12,4)|unsigned|Price of the previous day stock when the market close.|
|percent\_change\_price|decimal(8,4)||Price change percentage of previous day and latest day ((curr\_close\_price - prev\_close\_price) / curr\_close\_price)|
|metadata|text||Store any additional info of the company (eg: company's industry, company's desc, etc)|
|created\_at|bigint|unsigned, not null|unix timestamp in milliseconds|
|updated\_at|bigint|unsigned, not null|unix timestamp in milliseconds|
|stock\_exchange\_id|tinyint|unsigned, not null|Identifier to determine what exchange a company listed in, will be saved as static constant in the code Id 1 : Nasdaq Id 2 : NYSE|

* Index

|Name|Column|
|---|---|
|primary key|id|

# 2\. Getting In-Depth

In this section, we take a closer look at two pivotal components of Stockwatch's architecture: the Webservice and the Cron service. By examining the intricacies of these key elements, we uncover the inner workings of Stockwatch and gain a deeper understanding of how it fulfills its mission of delivering daily stock updates to Seatalk users and groups.

## 2.1 Webservice

This section explain the intricate workings of Stockwatch's Webservice component. As the backbone of the system, the Webservice enables smooth communication between users and the bot, handling requests for stock updates and ensuring timely delivery to Seatalk. In this section, we explore the complex mechanisms of Stockwatch's Webservice component. Serving as the system's foundation, the Webservice enables smooth communication between users and the bot, managing requests for stock updates and ensuring their prompt delivery to Seatalk.

We first setup the API routing for our web service

```go
const (
    rootPath = "stockbot/api"
)
 
func StartHttpServer() (stopFunc func()) {
    conf := configs.Get()
 
    gin.SetMode(gin.ReleaseMode)
    r := gin.Default()
    r.Use(middlewares.WithRequestId())
 
    r.GET(rootPath+"/v1/ping", handlers.HandlePing)
 
    r.Use(middlewares.WithSOPSignatureValidation(), middlewares.WithReportingMetrics())
 
    r.POST(rootPath+"/v1/callback", handlers.HandleSeatalkEventCallback)
 
    srv = &http.Server{
        Addr:   ":" + conf.HttpPort,
        Handler: r,
    }
 
    go func() {
        log.Printf("running %s in web service mode...\n", conf.AppName)
        log.Println("starting web, listening on", srv.Addr)
        err := srv.ListenAndServe()
        if err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
            log.Fatalln("failed starting web on", srv.Addr, err)
        }
    }()
 
    return func() {
        GracefulStop()
    }
}
 
func GracefulStop() {
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
    defer cancel()
 
    log.Println("shutting down web on", srv.Addr)
    if err := srv.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
        log.Fatalln("failed shutdown server", err)
    }
    log.Println("web gracefully stopped")
} Copy
```

for complete implementation, please refer to this[file.](https://git.garena.com/shopee/shopee-id/stock-bot/-/blob/master/cmd/webservice/main.go)

### **2.1.1 Event Handling**

First, for every event callback that our Bot receive, we need to parse and handle it. To handle all the events, the handler is implemented in the code snippet below. For complete handler can be seen in this[repository](https://git.garena.com/shopee/shopee-id/stock-bot/-/blob/master/cmd/webservice/handler/handler.go).

```go
var InternalError = dtos.SOPEventCallbackGenericResp{
    Message: constants.InternalServerErrorMsg,
}
 
func HandleSeatalkEventCallback(ctx *gin.Context) {
    var reqSOP dtos.SOPEventCallbackReq
    if err := ctx.BindJSON(&reqSOP); err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[HandleSeatalkEventCallback] failed read body request", logkit.Err(err))
        ctx.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, InternalError)
        return
    }
 
    switch reqSOP.EventType {
    case constants.EventVerification:
        HandleEventVerification(ctx, reqSOP)
    case constants.EventNewBotSubscriber, constants.EventBotAddedToGroup:
        HandleOnboardNewSubscriber(ctx, reqSOP)
    case constants.EventBotRemovedGromGroup:
        HandleOffboardSubscriber(ctx, reqSOP)
    case constants.EventMessageFromUser, constants.EventMessageFromGroup:
        HandleEventMsgFromSubscriber(ctx, reqSOP)
    default:
        HandleEventUnknown(ctx, reqSOP)
    }
}
 
func HandleEventVerification(ctx *gin.Context, reqSOP dtos.SOPEventCallbackReq) {
    ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, dtos.SOPEventVerificationResp{SeatalkChallenge: reqSOP.Event.SeatalkChallenge})
}
 
func HandleOnboardNewSubscriber(ctx *gin.Context, reqSOP dtos.SOPEventCallbackReq) {
    var (
        subsOrInviterEmployeeCode string
        groupID                  string
        groupName                string
    )
 
    if reqSOP.EventType == constants.EventNewBotSubscriber {
        subsOrInviterEmployeeCode = reqSOP.Event.EmployeeCode
    } else if reqSOP.EventType == constants.EventBotAddedToGroup {
        subsOrInviterEmployeeCode = reqSOP.Event.Inviter.EmployeeCode
        groupID = reqSOP.Event.Group.GroupId
        groupName = reqSOP.Event.Group.GroupName
    }
 
    err := usecase.OnboardNewSubscriber(ctx, dtos.NewSubscriberParam{
        EmployeeCode: subsOrInviterEmployeeCode,
        GroupID:     groupID,
        GroupName:   groupName,
    })
    if err != nil {
        ctx.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, InternalError)
        return
    }
    ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, dtos.SOPEventCallbackGenericResp{Message: "subscriber onboarded"})
}
 
func HandleOffboardSubscriber(ctx *gin.Context, reqSOP dtos.SOPEventCallbackReq) {
    err := usecase.OffBoardSubscriber(ctx, "", reqSOP.Event.GroupId)
    if err != nil {
        ctx.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, InternalError)
        return
    }
 
    ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, dtos.SOPEventCallbackGenericResp{Message: "subscriber offboarded"})
}
 
func HandleEventMsgFromSubscriber(ctx *gin.Context, reqSOP dtos.SOPEventCallbackReq) {
    var (
        msg         string
        employeeCode string
        groupId     string
    )
 
    if reqSOP.EventType == constants.EventMessageFromUser {
        msg = reqSOP.Event.Message.Text.Content
        employeeCode = reqSOP.Event.EmployeeCode
    } else if reqSOP.EventType == constants.EventMessageFromGroup {
        msg = reqSOP.Event.Message.Text.PlainText
        groupId = reqSOP.Event.GroupId
    }
 
    if err := usecase.ProcessSubscriberMessage(ctx, msg, employeeCode, groupId); err != nil {
        ctx.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, InternalError)
        return
    }
 
    ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, dtos.SOPEventCallbackGenericResp{Message: "event consumed"})
}
 
func HandleEventUnknown(ctx *gin.Context, reqSOP dtos.SOPEventCallbackReq) {
    logkit.Info("[HandleEventUnknown] received unknown event", logkit.Any("event_type", reqSOP.EventType))
    ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, dtos.SOPEventCallbackGenericResp{Message: "event consumed"})
} Copy
```

for complete implementation, please refer to this[file](https://git.garena.com/shopee/shopee-id/stock-bot/-/blob/master/cmd/webservice/handlers/seatalk_event_callback.go)

### **2.1.2 Feature 1: Welcome Greeting**

When an individual user subscribe to a bot, or when Bot invited to a group chat, we want that the Bot send a welcome greeting message to the user. Upon onboarding, we also add one stock to the user's watchlist (SE: Sea Limited). The expectation of this feature can be seen in this picture below.

**2.1.2.1 System Flow**

![](data:image/png;base64,)

**2.1.2.2 Related APIs and Events**

Some APIs and Events that related to this feature are:

* Event`[new\_bot\_subscriber](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/event_new_bot_subscriber)` : When an individual user subscribe to a bot
* Event`[bot\_added\_to\_group\_chat](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/event-bot-added-to-group-chat)` : When a bot is invited to a group chat
* API`[Get Employee Profile](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/get-employee-profile)`
* API`[Get User Language Preference](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/get-user-lang-pref)`

**2.1.2.3 Code Snippet**

After these event`new_bot_subscriber` and`bot_added_to_group_chat` handled, we will process it further here.

```go
func OnboardNewSubscriber(ctx context.Context, param dtos.NewSubscriberParam) error {
    logkit.FromContext(ctx).Info("[OnboardNewSubscriber] start onboarding new subscriber")
 
    if param.GroupID == "" {
        if err := deletePreviousEntityDataIfExists(ctx, param.EmployeeCode); err != nil {
            return err
        }
    }
 
    emp, err := clients.SOPGetEmployeeProfileByEmployeeCode(ctx, param.EmployeeCode)
    if err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[OnboardNewSubscriber] failed get employee profile", logkit.Err(err))
        return err
    }
 
    subscriber, err := buildSubscriber(ctx, param.EmployeeCode, param.GroupID, emp)
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }
 
    if err := saveSubscriberWithDefaultStock(ctx, subscriber); err != nil {
        return err
    }
 
    if err = sendOnboardMessage(ctx, param, emp.Name, subscriber); err != nil {
        return err
    }
 
    logkit.FromContext(ctx).Info("[OnboardNewSubscriber] finish onboarding new subscriber",
        logkit.Any("SubsOrInviterEmployeeCode", param.EmployeeCode),
        logkit.Any("GroupId", param.GroupID))
    return nil
}
 
func deletePreviousEntityDataIfExists(ctx context.Context, subsOrInviterEmployeeCode string) (err error) {
    // for an individual user, we need to clear previous user's data first
    // for a group subscriber, clearing data process is handled by event "bot_removed_from_group_chat"
    if err = OffBoardSubscriber(ctx, subsOrInviterEmployeeCode, ""); err != nil && err != constants.ErrRecordNotFound {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[OnboardNewSubscriber] failed to onboard old subscriber", logkit.Err(err))
        return err
    }
     
    logkit.FromContext(ctx).Info("[OnboardNewSubscriber] success to offboard subscriber that once subscribe to us")
    return nil
}
 
func buildSubscriber(ctx context.Context, subsOrInviterEmployeeCode, groupId string, emp *dtos.SeatalkEmployee) (*dtos.Subscriber, error) {
    subscriberRegion := emp.GetRegionFromLegalEntity(ctx)
 
    // might need to handle when user change their language preference
    language, err := clients.SOPGetEmployeeLanguagePreferenceBy(ctx, subsOrInviterEmployeeCode)
    if err != nil || language == "" {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[buildSubscriber] failed get employee language preference", logkit.Err(err))
        language = constants.LanguageEnglish
    }
 
    subscriber := dtos.Subscriber{
        EmployeeCode: emp.EmployeeCode,
        SeatalkId:   emp.SeatalkId,
        Region:      subscriberRegion,
        Language:    language,
        GroupId:     sql.NullString{},
    }
 
    if groupId != "" {
        subscriber.GroupId = sql.NullString{String: groupId, Valid: true}
    }
 
    return &subscriber, nil
}
 
func saveSubscriberWithDefaultStock(ctx context.Context, subscriber *dtos.Subscriber) error {
    tx, err := clients.DBBeginTransaction()
    if err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error(err.Error())
        return err
    }
    defer func(tx *sql.Tx) {
        if err = clients.DBRollbackTransaction(tx); err != nil {
            logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[OnboardNewSubscriber] failed rollback trx", logkit.Err(err))
        }
    }(tx)
 
    subscriberId, err := clients.DBInsertSubscriber(ctx, tx, subscriber)
    if err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error(err.Error())
        return err
    }
 
    // Add SEA stock to user's watchlist as the default stock
    seaStock, err := clients.DBGetStockByTicker(ctx, constants.DefaultCompanyTicker)
    if err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error(err.Error())
        return err
    }
 
    subsWatchlist := dtos.SubscriberWatchlist{
        SubscriberId:  uint64(subscriberId),
        StockCompanyId: seaStock.Id,
    }
 
    _, err = clients.DBInsertSubscriberWatchlist(ctx, tx, &subsWatchlist)
    if err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error(err.Error())
        return err
    }
 
    if err = clients.DBCommitTransaction(tx); err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error(err.Error())
        return err
    }
 
    return nil
}
 
func sendOnboardMessage(ctx context.Context, newSubscriber dtos.NewSubscriberParam, empName string, subscriber *dtos.Subscriber) error {
    var (
        onboardingParam = constants.OnboardingParam{
            Username: empName,
            BotName: configs.Get().BotName,
            Timezone: utils.GetTimezoneStrByRegion(subscriber.Region)}
        isGroupChat = newSubscriber.GroupID != ""
    )
 
    if isGroupChat {
        onboardingParam.Username = newSubscriber.GroupName
    }
 
    message, err := constants.CreateOnboardingResponse(false, onboardingParam)
    if err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[sendOnboardMessage] failed to create onboarding response", logkit.Err(err))
        return err
    }
 
    if err := clients.SOPSendMessageToSubscriber(ctx, message, newSubscriber.EmployeeCode, subscriber.GroupId.String); err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[sendOnboardMessage] failed send onboarding message", logkit.Err(err))
        return err
    }
 
    return nil
} Copy
```

for complete implementation, please refer to this[file.](https://git.garena.com/shopee/shopee-id/stock-bot/-/blob/master/usecase/onboard_new_subscriber.go)

### **2.1.3 Feature 2: Add Stock to Watchlist**

After user subscribe or add the Bot to the group chat, user can add company stock to their watchlist. Bot can receive US Stock that listed in NASDAQ and NYSE. On private chat, user can send command "/add STOCK_TICKER" and the Bot will add the stock to the watchlist, if the ticker is valid. On the group chat, user/participant in group chat need to mention the bot and then give the add command, "@Stockwatch /add STOCK_TICKER" so that the Bot can recognize and add the stock to the watchlist. The expected functionality can be seen in pictures below.

**2.1.3.1 System Flow**

![](data:image/png;base64,)

**2.1.3.2 Related APIs and Events**

* Event`[message\_from\_bot\_subscriber](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/event_message_received_from_bot_subscriber)` : When a user send any message to the Bot in private chat
* Event`[new\_mentioned\_message\_received\_from\_group\_chat](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/event_new_mentioned_message_from_group_chat)` : When a user send a message that mentioned the Bot in the group chat
* API`[Send Message to a Bot Subscriber](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/messaging_send-message-to-bot-subscriber_)`
* API`[Send Message to Group Chat](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/Send-Message-to-Group-Chat)`

**2.1.3.3 Code Snippet**

After these event`message_from_bot_subscriber` and`new_mentioned_message_received_from_group_chat` handled, they will be processed further here.

```go
func AddStockToWatchlist(ctx context.Context, params dtos.AddStockToWatchlistParams) error {
    subscriber, err := GetSubscriberByEmployeeCodeOrGroupId(ctx, params.EmployeeCode, params.GroupID)
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }
 
    watchlist, err := clients.DBGetStockSubscriberWatchlistBySubscriberId(ctx, subscriber.Id)
    if err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[AddStockToWatchlist] failed to get subscriber's watchlist", logkit.Err(err), logkit.Any("subscriber_id", subscriber.Id))
        return err
    }
 
    if len(watchlist) >= configs.Get().MaxNumberStockWatchlist {
        return sendWatchlistReachedMaxCapacityMsg(ctx, params, dtos.ExtractStockIdsFromSubscriberWatchlist(watchlist))
    }
 
    if isValidTickerSymbol := len(params.Ticker) <= constants.MaxTickerLength; !isValidTickerSymbol {
        return sendInvalidTickerMsg(ctx, params)
    }
 
    stock, err := getStockAndSyncFromUpstreamIfNotExists(ctx, params)
    if err != nil {
        if err == constants.ErrStockNotFoundStockAnalysis {
            return sendInvalidTickerMsg(ctx, params)
        }
        return err
    }
 
    _, err = clients.DBInsertSubscriberWatchlist(ctx, nil, &dtos.SubscriberWatchlist{SubscriberId: subscriber.Id, StockCompanyId: stock.Id})
    if err == constants.ErrRecordDuplicate {
        return sendDuplicateTickerMsg(ctx, params)
    } else if err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[handleTickerValidationAndAddToWatchlist] failed to insert stock watchlist", logkit.Err(err))
        return err
    }
 
    return sendSuccessfullyAddNewTickerMsg(ctx, params)
}
 
func sendInvalidTickerMsg(ctx context.Context, params dtos.AddStockToWatchlistParams) error {
    msgToSend, err := constants.CreateResponseWithTemplate(constants.AddWatchlistTickerNotFound, constants.AddWatchlistTickerNotFoundParam{
        Ticker: params.Ticker,
        BotName: configs.Get().BotName,
    })
    if err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[handleTickerValidationAndAddToWatchlist] failed to create error response", logkit.Err(err), logkit.Any("param", params))
        return err
    }
 
    if err := clients.SOPSendMessageToSubscriber(ctx, msgToSend, params.EmployeeCode, params.GroupID); err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[handleTickerValidationAndAddToWatchlist] failed to send AddWatchlistTickerNotFound msg to user", logkit.Err(err))
        return err
    }
 
    return nil
}
 
func sendDuplicateTickerMsg(ctx context.Context, params dtos.AddStockToWatchlistParams) error {
    var isGroupChat = params.GroupID != ""
    msgToSend, err := constants.CreateAddWatchlistCommonResponse(isGroupChat, constants.AddWatchlistAlreadyExist, constants.AddWatchlistParam{Ticker: params.Ticker})
    if err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[handleTickerValidationAndAddToWatchlist] failed to create AddWatchlistAlreadyExist response", logkit.Err(err))
        return err
    }
 
    if err := clients.SOPSendMessageToSubscriber(ctx, msgToSend, params.EmployeeCode, params.GroupID); err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[handleTickerValidationAndAddToWatchlist] failed to send AddWatchlistAlreadyExist msg to user", logkit.Err(err))
        return err
    }
    return nil
}
 
func sendWatchlistReachedMaxCapacityMsg(ctx context.Context, params dtos.AddStockToWatchlistParams, stockIds []uint64) error {
    var isGroupChat = params.GroupID != ""
 
    stocks, err := clients.DBGetStocksByStockIds(ctx, stockIds)
    if err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[sendWatchlistReachedMaxCapacityMsg] failed to get stock watchlist detail", logkit.Err(err))
        return err
    }
 
    msgToSend, err := constants.CreateAddWatchlistMaxCapacityResponse(isGroupChat, constants.ErrorFullWatchlist, constants.ErrorFullWatchlistParam{
        MaxCapacity: configs.Get().MaxNumberStockWatchlist,
        WatchList:  dtos.BuildWatchlistStrFromStocks(stocks),
    })
    if err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[sendWatchlistReachedMaxCapacityMsg] failed to create AddWatchlistMaxCapacity response", logkit.Err(err))
        return err
    }
 
    if err := clients.SOPSendMessageToSubscriber(ctx, msgToSend, params.EmployeeCode, params.GroupID); err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[sendWatchlistReachedMaxCapacityMsg] failed to send AddWatchlistMaxCapacity msg to user", logkit.Err(err))
        return err
    }
 
    return nil
}
 
func getStockAndSyncFromUpstreamIfNotExists(ctx context.Context, params dtos.AddStockToWatchlistParams) (*dtos.StockCompany, error) {
    syncAllStockDataWithUpstreamFunc := func(ctx context.Context, stockExchangeName string) error {
        stockExchangeID := constants.CodeStockExchangeMap[strings.ToUpper(stockExchangeName)]
        if isStockExchangeIsNotSupported := stockExchangeID == 0; isStockExchangeIsNotSupported {
            return constants.ErrRecordNotFound
        }
 
        allStockFromUpstream, err := clients.StockAnalysisGetAllStocks(ctx, stockExchangeID)
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }
 
        allTickers, err := clients.DBGetAllStocksTickerByStockExchangeId(ctx, stockExchangeID)
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }
 
        // There might be a race condition when 2 subscribers, at the same time add new stock to our system
        // so the insert process will be failed, but that case should be very rare.
        generateStockBulkInsertionDataFunc := func() (newStocksFromUpstream []*dtos.StockCompany) {
            var tickerMapper = map[string]struct{}{}
            for _, ticker := range allTickers {
                tickerMapper[ticker] = struct{}{}
            }
 
            for idx, stock := range allStockFromUpstream.Data {
                _, exists := tickerMapper[stock.Ticker]
                if isNewStock := !exists; isNewStock {
                    newStocksFromUpstream = append(newStocksFromUpstream,
                        &dtos.StockCompany{
                            Ticker:     allStockFromUpstream.Data[idx].Ticker,
                            CompanyName: allStockFromUpstream.Data[idx].CompanyName,
                        })
                }
            }
            return
        }
        insertionData := generateStockBulkInsertionDataFunc()
 
        if len(insertionData) > 0 {
            return clients.DBInsertStockCompanyBatch(ctx, insertionData, stockExchangeID)
        }
        return nil
    }
 
    stock, err := clients.DBGetStockByTicker(ctx, params.Ticker)
    if err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Info("[handleTickerValidationAndAddToWatchlist] failed get stock by ticker to db, will try to external API", logkit.Err(err))
 
        stockAnalysis, err := clients.StockAnalysisGetAnalysis(ctx, params.Ticker)
        if err != nil {
            logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[syncAllStockDataWithUpstream] failed to check if ticker exist or stockModel is not exist", logkit.Err(err))
            return nil, err
        }
 
        if err := syncAllStockDataWithUpstreamFunc(ctx, stockAnalysis.Exchange); err != nil {
            msg := constants.AddWatchlistUnknownError
            if err == constants.ErrRecordNotFound {
                msg, err = constants.CreateResponseWithTemplate(constants.AddWatchlistTickerNotFound, constants.AddWatchlistTickerNotFoundParam{
                    Ticker: params.Ticker,
                    BotName: configs.Get().BotName,
                })
                if err != nil {
                    logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[handleTickerValidationAndAddToWatchlist] failed to create error response", logkit.Err(err), logkit.Any("param", params))
                    return nil, err
                }
            }
 
            if err := clients.SOPSendMessageToSubscriber(ctx, msg, params.EmployeeCode, params.GroupID); err != nil {
                logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[handleTickerValidationAndAddToWatchlist] failed to send msg to user", logkit.Err(err), logkit.Any("msg", msg))
                return nil, err
            }
        }
 
        stock, err = clients.DBGetStockByTicker(ctx, params.Ticker)
        if err == constants.ErrRecordNotFound {
            msgToSend, err := constants.CreateResponseWithTemplate(constants.AddWatchlistTickerNotFound, constants.AddWatchlistTickerNotFoundParam{
                Ticker: params.Ticker,
                BotName: configs.Get().BotName,
            })
            if err != nil {
                logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[handleTickerValidationAndAddToWatchlist] failed to create error response", logkit.Err(err), logkit.Any("param", params))
                return nil, err
            }
 
            if err := clients.SOPSendMessageToSubscriber(
                ctx,
                msgToSend,
                params.EmployeeCode,
                params.GroupID,
            ); err != nil {
                logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[handleTickerValidationAndAddToWatchlist] failed to send AddWatchlistTickerNotFound msg to user", logkit.Err(err))
                return nil, err
            }
        } else if err != nil {
            logkit.FromContext(ctx).Info("[handleTickerValidationAndAddToWatchlist] failed get stock by ticker from db", logkit.Err(err))
            return nil, err
        }
    }
    return stock, nil
}
 
func sendSuccessfullyAddNewTickerMsg(ctx context.Context, params dtos.AddStockToWatchlistParams) error {
    var isGroupChat = params.GroupID != ""
    msgToSend, err := constants.CreateAddWatchlistCommonResponse(isGroupChat, constants.AddWatchlistSuccess, constants.AddWatchlistParam{Ticker: params.Ticker})
    if err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[handleTickerValidationAndAddToWatchlist] failed to create AddWatchlistSuccess response", logkit.Err(err))
        return err
    }
 
    if err := clients.SOPSendMessageToSubscriber(ctx, msgToSend, params.EmployeeCode, params.GroupID); err != nil {
        logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[handleTickerValidationAndAddToWatchlist] failed to send AddWatchlistSuccess msg to user", logkit.Err(err))
        return err
    }
    return nil
} Copy
```

## 2.2 Cron Service

In this section, we explore the essential role played by Stockwatch's Cron service. Tasked with scheduling and executing daily stock update tasks, the Cron service ensures that users receive accurate and timely stock information price update without fail, contributing to the reliability and efficiency of the Stockwatch system.

### **2.2.1 Feature 3: Send Daily Stock Price Update**

Now, every subscriber already have stock watchlist. Every 9AM everyday, Bot will send message to the user, bot in private chat and group chat, about their stock price update. The message will contain list of stock, which include the stock ticker, stock company name, closing price, and price change percentage. The expected functionality can be seen in pictures below.

**2.2.1.1 System Flow**

![](data:image/png;base64,)

**2.2.1.2 Related APIs and Events**

* API`[Send Message to a Bot Subscriber](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/messaging_send-message-to-bot-subscriber_)`
* API`[Send Message to Group Chat](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/Send-Message-to-Group-Chat)`

**2.2.1.3 Code Snippet**

```go
const (
	holidayFinnhubDateFormat = "2006-01-02"
)

func SendDailyWatchlist(ctx context.Context, regions []string) error {
	processStartTime := time.Now()

	// 1. check if the market was open yesterday. If market was closed, can skip sending the daily update message.
	if isNeedToSendDaily := checkNeedToSendDaily(ctx); !isNeedToSendDaily {
		logkit.FromContext(ctx).Info("[SendDailyWatchlist] yesterday's US market is closed, will skip send daily message today")
		return nil
	}

	// 2. Get all stocks that added by all user in their watchlist, and we'll try to get the stock price information.
	// If the price is not the latest one, we will update the stock price.
	mapStockIdToIsUpdated, err := updateOutdatedStockPrices(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	updatedStocksInWatchlist, err := clients.GetDistinctStockInWatchlist(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[SendDailyWatchlist] failed DBGetDistinctStockIdWatchlist", logkit.Err(err))
		return err
	}

	mapStockIdToMsg, err := createStockIdToMsgMapper(updatedStocksInWatchlist, mapStockIdToIsUpdated)
	if err != nil {
		logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[SendDailyWatchlist] failed buildStocksWatchlistString", logkit.Err(err))
	}

	// 3. For each user, we will construct the daily message using the user's stock watchlist and the price update of each stock
	subsWatchlist, err := clients.DBGetSubscribersAndWatchlistByRegions(ctx, regions)
	if err != nil {
		logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[SendDailyWatchlist] failed DBGetSubscribersAndWatchlistByRegions", logkit.Err(err))
		return err
	}

	// 4. Send the daily update price message, both to individual user or group chat
	// In this process, there is a possibility where we got error code 101 (https://open.seatalk.io/docs/reference_server-api-error-code),
	// that is we get rate limited by the API. If we got that error, we will wait (sleep the process) for one minute, and we'll retry again.
	successfulMsgCount, failedMsgCount := sendDailyMsgToUserWithRetry(ctx, subsWatchlist, mapStockIdToMsg)

	logkit.FromContext(ctx).Info("[SendDailyWatchlist] Finish sending daily watchlist to subscribers in region",
		logkit.Any("duration", time.Since(processStartTime)), logkit.Strings("regions", regions),
		logkit.Int("successful_msg_count", successfulMsgCount), logkit.Int("failed_msg_count", failedMsgCount))
	return nil

}

func checkNeedToSendDaily(ctx context.Context) bool {
	timeNow := time.Now()

	if utils.IsYesterdayWeekend(timeNow) {
		return false
	}

	holidaysData, err := clients.StockGetUSMarketHolidayFromFinnhub(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[checkNeedToSendDaily] failed to get market holiday list from Finnhub", logkit.Err(err))
		return true
	}

	timeYesterday := timeNow.Add(-24 * time.Hour)
	timeYesterdayFormatted := timeYesterday.Format(holidayFinnhubDateFormat)

	for _, holiday := range holidaysData.Holidays {
		if holiday.TradingHour == "" {
			holidayDate, err := time.Parse(holidayFinnhubDateFormat, holiday.Date)
			if err != nil {
				logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[checkNeedToSendDaily] something wrong when parse date", logkit.Err(err))
				continue
			}
			holidayDateFormatted := holidayDate.Format(holidayFinnhubDateFormat)

			if timeYesterdayFormatted == holidayDateFormatted {
				return false
			}
		}
	}

	return true
}

func createStockIdToMsgMapper(stocksWatchlist []*dtos.StockCompany, mapStockIdToIsUpdated map[uint64]bool) (map[uint64]string, error) {
	var (
		err             error
		mapStockIdToMsg = map[uint64]string{}
	)

	for _, stock := range stocksWatchlist {
		// If after update, the price stock still not updated, will make it as empty string so user will receive error message
		mapStockIdToMsg[stock.Id] = ""
		if mapStockIdToIsUpdated[stock.Id] {
			mapStockIdToMsg[stock.Id], err = buildIndividualStockMsg(*stock)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}
	}
	return mapStockIdToMsg, nil
}

func updateOutdatedStockPrices(ctx context.Context) (map[uint64]bool, error) {
	var (
		mapStockIsPriceUpdated = map[uint64]bool{}
	)

	stocksInWatchlist, err := clients.GetDistinctStockInWatchlist(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[SendDailyWatchlist] failed to get distinct stocks in all user's watchlist", logkit.Err(err))
		return nil, err
	}

	for _, stocks := range stocksInWatchlist {
		// Need to check if the stock price is not yet updated, we need to retry to update the price
		stockPriceOutdated := (time.Now().Unix() - int64(stocks.UpdatedAt)) >= constants.OneDayInSeconds

		if !stockPriceOutdated &&
			stocks.CurrClosePrice.Valid &&
			stocks.PrevClosePrice.Valid &&
			stocks.CurrOpenPrice.Valid &&
			stocks.PercentChangePrice.Valid {
			mapStockIsPriceUpdated[stocks.Id] = true
		}
	}

	mapStockIsPriceUpdated, _, err = UpdateAllStockPrice(ctx, stocksInWatchlist, mapStockIsPriceUpdated)
	if err != nil {
		logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[SendDailyWatchlist] failed when try to UpdateAllStockPrice, some stock price may not be updated", logkit.Err(err))
	}

	return mapStockIsPriceUpdated, nil
}

func buildIndividualStockMsg(stock dtos.StockCompany) (string, error) {
	stockName := stock.CompanyName
	stockTicker := stock.Ticker

	closePrice := stock.CurrClosePrice.Decimal.InexactFloat64()
	changePercentage := stock.PercentChangePrice.Decimal.InexactFloat64()
	signStr := ""
	if changePercentage >= 0 {
		signStr = "+"
	}
	stringStock, err := constants.CreateResponseWithTemplate(constants.DailyStockIndividualFormat, constants.DailyStockIndividualParam{
		Ticker:           stockTicker,
		StockName:        stockName,
		ClosePrice:       closePrice,
		SignStr:          signStr,
		ChangePercentage: changePercentage,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	return stringStock, nil
}

func sendDailyMsgToUserWithRetry(ctx context.Context, subsWatchlist []*dtos.SubscriberWatchlistJoin, mapStockIdToMsg map[uint64]string) (int, int) {
	var (
		successfulMsgCount int
		failedMsgCount     int
		rateLimiterTag     = "sendDailyMsgToUserWithRetry"
	)

	createDailyUpdateMsgFunc := func(stockIdsStr []string, stockDetails map[uint64]string, region string) string {
		isStockPriceUpdated := true
		timeStockUpdated := time.Now().AddDate(0, 0, -1)

		date := timeStockUpdated.Format(constants.DailyStockDateFormat)
		viewWatchlist := []string{}

		for idx, stockIdStr := range stockIdsStr {
			stockId, _ := strconv.Atoi(stockIdStr)

			if stockDetails[uint64(stockId)] == "" {
				isStockPriceUpdated = false
				break
			}

			stringStock := fmt.Sprintf(`%d\. %s`, idx+1, stockDetails[uint64(stockId)])

			viewWatchlist = append(viewWatchlist, stringStock)
		}

		if !isStockPriceUpdated {
			return constants.DailyStockUpdateFailed
		}

		viewWatchlistString := strings.Join(viewWatchlist, "\n")
		gmtStr := utils.GetTimezoneStrByRegion(region)

		msg, err := constants.CreateResponseWithTemplate(constants.DailyStockUpdateSuccess, constants.DailyStockUpdateSuccessParam{
			WatchList: viewWatchlistString,
			Date:      date,
			GMTStr:    gmtStr,
		})
		if err != nil {
			msg = constants.DailyStockUpdateFailed
		}

		return msg
	}

	sendDailyMsgFunc := func(ctx context.Context, sub *dtos.SubscriberWatchlistJoin, mapStockIdToMsg map[uint64]string) error {
		stockIdsStr := strings.Split(sub.Watchlist, ",")
		msgToSend := createDailyUpdateMsgFunc(stockIdsStr, mapStockIdToMsg, sub.Region)

		cache := clients.GetLocalCache()

		if !clients.IsSOPSendMessageToSubscriberAllowed(cache, rateLimiterTag) {
			err := constants.ErrLocalRateLimitReachedSOP
			logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[sendMsgToUserWithRetry] failed when send msg to subscriber because of local rate limit, start sleep then retry",
				logkit.Err(err), logkit.Uint64("subscriber_id", sub.SubscriberId))

			sleepDuration := time.Second
			if configs.Get().RateLimit.SOPRequestUnit == int(clients.RATE_LIMIT_MINUTE) {
				sleepDuration = time.Minute
			}
			time.Sleep(sleepDuration)
			return err
		}

		err := clients.SOPSendMessageToSubscriber(ctx, msgToSend, sub.EmployeeCode, sub.GroupId.String)
		if err == constants.ErrRateLimitReachedSOP {
			logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[sendMsgToUserWithRetry] failed when send msg to subscriber because of rate limit, start sleep for some time and then retry",
				logkit.Err(err), logkit.Uint64("subscriber_id", sub.SubscriberId))

			// Add sleep 1 minute here, because the rate limit is in per minute range
			time.Sleep(60 * time.Second)
		}

		if isGroup := sub.GroupId.String != ""; isGroup {
			reporter.ReportCounter("seatalkbot_send_daily_stock_updates", 1, reporter.Label{Key: "entity_type", Val: "group"})
		} else {
			reporter.ReportCounter("seatalkbot_send_daily_stock_updates", 1, reporter.Label{Key: "entity_type", Val: "user"})
		}

		clients.IncrementRequestCount(cache, rateLimiterTag, clients.RateLimitType(configs.Get().RateLimit.SOPRequestUnit))

		return err
	}

	for i := 0; i < len(subsWatchlist); i++ {
		sub := subsWatchlist[i]

		for retryCounter := 1; retryCounter <= configs.Get().MaxRetryDailyMsg; retryCounter++ {
			var err error
			if err = sendDailyMsgFunc(ctx, sub, mapStockIdToMsg); err == nil {
				successfulMsgCount++
				break
			}
			logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error("[sendMsgToUserWithRetry] failed when send msg to subscriber and will retry",
				logkit.Err(err), logkit.String("employee_code", sub.EmployeeCode), logkit.String("group_id", sub.GroupId.String), logkit.Int("retry_count", retryCounter))

			if retryCounter == configs.Get().MaxRetryDailyMsg {
				errMsg := fmt.Sprintf("[sendMsgToUserWithRetry] After retried for %d times, still failed to send daily watchlist to subscriber", retryCounter-1)
				logkit.FromContext(ctx).Error(errMsg, logkit.String("employee_code", sub.EmployeeCode), logkit.String("group_id", sub.GroupId.String))
				failedMsgCount++
			}
		}
	}

	return successfulMsgCount, failedMsgCount
} Copy
```

for complete implementation, please refer to this[file.](https://git.garena.com/shopee/shopee-id/stock-bot/-/blob/master/usecase/send_daily_watchlist.go)

Initially, we need to check whether it is necessary to send the daily message by checking if the market was open yesterday. If market was closed, can skip sending the daily update message. Subsequently, we will retrieve all stocks added by users to their watchlists and attempt to acquire the latest stock price information. If the price is outdated, we will update it accordingly. Following this, we will generate the daily message for each user utilizing their stock watchlist and the updated price of each stock. Lastly, we will dispatch the daily update price message to individual users or group chats.

There is a chance where we got error code`101` (Error Code[documentation](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/reference_server-api-error-code)) when trying to send a message, this means we already reach the rate limit threshold. If such an error occurs, we will suspend the process for one minute before attempting to retry. For more info, can see Send Message to a Bot Subscriber API[docs](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/messaging_send-message-to-bot-subscriber_) and Send Message to Group Chat[docs](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/Send-Message-to-Group-Chat).
